class.name: FlowWaitNode
class.brief_description: Waits a number of seconds before the execution continues.
class.description: The wait node has the flow input [code]in[/code] and the flow output [code]out[/code]. When the execution reaches it, the playback pauses the graph for [member seconds] and then continues at [code]out[/code]. Its runtime behavior comes with the playback, which is a later feature; until then the node only has its properties and ports. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var wait := FlowWaitNode.new() wait.seconds = 2.5 graph.add_node(wait) [/gdscript] [csharp] var wait = new FlowWaitNode { Seconds = 2.5 }; graph.AddNode(wait); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The time to wait, in seconds. Negative values are set to [code]0.0[/code].
